Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)
Referred Sections: CMM-609.7: Lumbar Fusion (with or without Decompression) Following Failed Lumbar Disc Arthroplasty Surgery

Required findings: Post‑operative imaging demonstrates implant malposition or failure (e.g., subsidence, loosening, infection, dislocation, subluxation, vertebral body fracture, or dislodgement)
Clinical symptoms consistent with implant failure (e.g., worsening back pain, radiculopathy) documented in the record
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.7 > Failed Lumbar Disc Arthroplasty Implant

Required findings: ≥ 6 months elapsed since the lumbar total disc arthroplasty at the same level
Post‑operative MRI or CT shows compression of neural structures (e.g., retained disc material or recurrent disc herniation)
The case also satisfies the applicable procedure‑specific criteria in CMM‑609.4 (Lumbar Fusion with Decompression) or CMM‑609.5 (Lumbar Fusion without Decompression)
Clinical symptoms consistent with neural compression (e.g., radicular pain, neurologic deficit) documented
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.7 > Evidence of Neural Structure Compression

Non-Indications: Less than six months have passed since the prior lumbar disc arthroplasty at the same level
No imaging evidence of implant malposition, loosening, infection, dislocation, subluxation, fracture, or dislodgement
No MRI/CT evidence of neural structure compression when that is the claimed indication
Failure to meet the procedure‑specific criteria outlined in CMM‑609.4 or CMM‑609.5 when neural compression is the basis for surgery
Indications that do not fall under either implant failure or neural compression as defined by the policy
Important criteria & exceptions: Either implant failure OR neural structure compression qualifies the procedure; both are not required simultaneously
A minimum interval of >6 months since the original disc arthroplasty is mandatory for the neural compression pathway
When neural compression is the indication, the case must also satisfy the separate lumbar fusion criteria in CMM‑609.4 or CMM‑609.5
Post‑operative imaging must be performed and documented to demonstrate the specific failure or compression
Documentation required: Operative report of the original lumbar disc arthroplasty including date of surgery
Post‑operative imaging report (X‑ray, CT, or MRI) showing implant malposition or failure, if applicable
MRI or CT report demonstrating neural structure compression, if that is the indication
Clinical notes documenting symptoms, severity, and functional impairment related to the failure or compression
Verification that ≥6 months have elapsed since the arthroplasty (e.g., dated notes or timeline chart)
Documentation that the case meets the applicable CMM‑609.4 or CMM‑609.5 criteria (fusion with or without decompression) when neural compression is cited
